missing. I feel
like I didn't steal

I dunno why. Is being cute not enough?
No...
Cuteness is all-powerful. Then...

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян gets lost in her thoughts. I
think
she's doing great, personally, but...

Even on the way back to Tokyo, Curren
Chan
goes through bouts of silence.

I decide to leave her be, so I scroll
through social
media and find...
Hm? Umatter?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
"I saw Curren run for the first time. Turns
out
sprints are pretty cool."

keep an eye on her."

"#CuteCurrenChan"...

text_block_list.text:
Wow... So more people are getting into
sprints.
It's not happening very fast, but
I'm glad...

text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, they are!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
You can't even blink. You just have to
hold your
breath and keep your eyes
peeled. That's why I
love sprints!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
All I need is a minute. In one minute, I
can steal
everyone's hearts. That's why
they're so
interesting!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян's eyes light up. I think
sprints really
match her personality as
well.

...But I don't want to be an afterimage
that fades
once that minute ends. I want
to be engraved in
their hearts.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I want to be in everyone's hearts forever!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...My next race is the Sprinters Stakes.
I've gotta
make sure I finish my
homework by then.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I have to think... and figure out what I
need to fill
everyone's hearts with
cuteness.

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
The next race is our big goal—the
Sprinters
Stakes. Let's hope she can find
